correctness.rationale: Exact simplicial pushout yields natural degree-shifting Mayer-Vietoris isomorphisms. The fold matching explicitly collapses independence complexes under neighborhood inclusion; repeatedly pruning every nontrivial forest component gives a matching of c edges. Its independent-set complex is a two-hub graph with c parallel paths, yielding the integral wedge. The nested matching maps are explicit primitive graph-cycle injections, and C6 produces a three-edge matching complement. The included fresh checker compared all faces and mod-two homology of 328 forest instances plus 24 additional cases and was replayed successfully. Finite testing is corroboration, not the general proof.
